instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. On a dirt path in a wooded park, the man in the blue short-sleeved shirt (R1) and the woman in the grey blazer (R2) walk side-by-side. The man (R1) on the left looks down at their linked arms with a gentle smile, while the woman (R2) on the right looks forward. Her right arm is linked through his left arm, their hands clasped together. Soft natural daylight illuminates the green foliage and path.
